# Contributing to dsGeospatial

This outlines how to propose a change to dsGeospatial.

* Open an issue to ask for help or describe a function to be integrated.
* Agree with maintainers on the requirements.
* Fork the package and clone onto your computer. 
* Pull the latest changes from the main repository. 
* Create a dedicated branch for the issue.
* Implement and test the changes.
* Open a pull request linked to the issue , use issue number in the body and tag the maintainer.
* The maintainer reviews and decides the fate of the merge the pull request.


### Code style

*  New code should follow the tidyverse [style guide](https://style.tidyverse.org). 

*  We use [roxygen2](https://cran.r-project.org/package=roxygen2), with [Markdown syntax](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/roxygen2/vignettes/rd-formatting.html), for documentation.  

*  We use [testthat](https://cran.r-project.org/package=testthat) for unit tests. 
   Contributions with test cases included are easier to accept.
